injuries.shortComment: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that DeVito is the team's starting quarterback, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports. "We're excited about that. He had a good preseason, and Tommy's improved," Vrabel said of DeVito.
injuries.longComment: With Drake Maye (fibula) hurt early in Week 10 against Detroit, DeVito stepped in at quarterback but managed to complete just 12 of 24 pass attempts for 81 yards, a touchdown and an interception. He added 19 yards on four carries. The 28-year-old does have some starting experience -- he helmed the Giants offense for eight starts between 2023 and 2024 -- but he didn't play at all in 2025. For now, the Patriots are at least communicating that they'll stand pat and not look for help at quarterback outside the organization. However, the team is barely hanging on in the AFC playoff race with a 5-5 record, and with only rookie Behren Morton on the active roster as a healthy option to DeVito, the team may still look elsewhere if DeVito is unable to show better production.

injuries.shortComment: The Patriots designated Vera-Tucker (hamstring) for return from injured reserve Monday.
injuries.longComment: The move opens Vera-Tucker's 21-day practice window. The oft-injured offensive lineman went down in the Patriots' Week 6 win over the Jets. Greg Van Roten started New England's last game at left guard.

injuries.shortComment: For now, Maye -- who suffered a fractured right fibula during a Week 10 loss to the Lions -- remains on the Patriots' 53-man roster rather than injured reserve, with coach Mike Vrabel citing the "balance" the team is hoping to strike with regard to managing its remaining designated to return from IR slots, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Per Reiss, teams are limited to eight players that can be designated to return from the list over the course of the regular season, and the Patriots are close to using them all. "Right now, he's not on injured reserve," Vrabel said Monday. "He's on the active roster, so that's where it is today. I think that those things are obviously fluid. But we want to try to give him every opportunity that we can to be back at some point in time. I don't know when that will be; I'm not sure. But also, try to manage the roster and do what we need to do to try to win each week." On Sunday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported that Maye was on track to miss at least six weeks, a timetable that suggests, in a best-case scenario, the QB could make a push for a late-season return or for the postseason, should New England qualify. Heading into a Week 12 game against the Chargers, Tommy DeVito is slated to work as the team's starter, with rookie Behren Morton on hand as his backup. Additionally, there's the possibility that the team considers Daniel Jones -- who the Colts let go Friday -- as an alternative, but Vrabel told Reiss that in the short term at least, adding another signal-caller is not something that's being planned.

injuries.shortComment: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that Doubs (shoulder) may be cleared to return to practice later in the week, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.
injuries.longComment: Doubs, who last suited up Week 6, is eligible to return from injured reserve at any point, but Vrabel's comments suggests that the wideout isn't a lock to be reinstated ahead of Sunday's game against the Chargers. With fellow wideout A.J. Brown (hamstring) unlikely to play Week 12 and potentially set to miss additional time beyond that, a prominent role in the passing attack could be available for Doubs once's he ready to play. However, Doubs will eventually make his return to an offense missing Drake Maye (fibula), with Tommy DeVito in line to replace Maye as the team's starting quarterback beginning this Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Elliss logged 10 tackles (three solo) during the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions in Week 10 in Munich.
injuries.longComment: Week 10 was the third time this season that Elliss posted double-digit stops, and he ended up co-leading the Patriots in tackles with safety Kevin Byard. Through 10 regular-season games, Elliss has accumulated 75 tackles (37 solo), including 1.5 sacks, one pass defense and one forced fumble. The Patriots are on a bye for Week 11, so Elliss's next opportunity to suit up is Week 12 against the Chargers on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Byard registered 10 tackles (three solo) and two pass defenses (including an interception) during the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions in Week 10 in Munich.
injuries.longComment: Byard picked off a Jared Goff pass intended for Jameson Williams in the end zone late in the second quarter, which halted the Lions' red zone drive in its tracks. It was the first time this season that Byard posted double-digit stops, and each of the veteran safety's two interceptions on the year have come over his last three outings. He enters the Week 11 bye with 53 tackles (26 solo) and five pass defenses through 10 regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Williams failed to haul in his lone target during the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions on Sunday in Munich.
injuries.longComment: Williams did have a 21-yard carry late in the third quarter, although the play was nullified by offsetting penalties. It was the second straight game that the second-year wide receiver did not record a catch and the fifth time in 10 regular-season contests. New England is on a bye for Week 11, but the offense's outlook looks grim given that franchise quarterback Drake Maye is expected to miss time due to an ankle injury that he sustained in the first quarter of Sunday's game. The Patriots' next game takes place in Week 12 against the Chargers on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Larison turned his lone carry into two yards and caught two of three targets for 15 yards and a touchdown during the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions on Sunday in Munich. He also recorded a tackle on special teams.
injuries.longComment: The Patriots lost starting quarterback Drake Maye to an ankle injury early in the first quarter, so backup Tommy DeVito was under center for most of contest. New England struggled with DeVito at the helm, but he did connect with Larison for a 10-yard touchdown pass early in the fourth quarter in what was the Patriots' lone trip to the end zone. Even though that score came in garbage time, it was the first touchdown of Larison's NFL career, although he's firmly entrenched as the team's RB3 behind Rhamondre Stevenson and Corey Kiner. The Patriots are on a bye for Week 11, so their next game will take place in Week 12 against the Chargers on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Chism did not catch his only target during the Patriots' 35-10 loss against the Lions in Munich in Week 10.
injuries.longComment: A.J. Brown (hamstring) returned from a two-game absence caused by ankle and knee injuries in Week 10, and as a result, Chism saw his lowest snap count this season (8) since he was a healthy scratch in Week 1. His role coming out of the Patriots' bye in Week 11 will probably depend heavily on the availability of Brown, who picked up a hamstring issue against the Lions.

injuries.shortComment: Raridon caught his only target for six yards in Sunday's loss to the Lions in Munich.
injuries.longComment: The rookie tight end played his normal allotment of plays, seeing 62.7 percent of the offensive snaps, but the offense as a whole was broken after Drake Maye went out with an ankle injury early in the first quarter. The offense bogged down with Tommy DeVito at the controls, and Raridon's one target was his fewest in a game since Week 2. Raridon also has been held to single-digit receiving yards in two of the last three contests. He's averaging a robust 13.6 yards per catch this season but isn't a reliable fantasy option with Hunter Henry healthy.

injuries.shortComment: Borregales made his sole field-goal attempt and one PAT in the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Borregales made a 33-yard field goal on the first drive of the game. The kicker is now 11-for-13 on field-goal attempts and 24-for-25 on PATs through 10 regular-season games in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: Douglas caught one of three passes for four yards during the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions on Sunday in Munich.
injuries.longComment: The Patriots' offense was effective on the first drive of the game, but that was where the good news ended for New England after Drake Maye was knocked out for the rest of the contest due to an ankle injury. Tommy DeVito took over under center, and the offense struggled to move down the field for the rest of the game. For Douglas, it was the third time this season that he was held to one catch, with the last instance taking place in Week 3 against the Jaguars. A.J. Brown -- who was cleared to return from a two-game absence due to knee and ankle injuries -- also picked up a hamstring injury during Sunday's game, so Douglas could be the New England's WR1 following the Week 11 bye. The Patriots' next game takes place in Week 12 against the Chargers on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Henry caught two of three passes for 22 yards during the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions on Sunday in Munich.
injuries.longComment: Both of Henry's catches of 10 and 12 yards came on the Patriots' first offensive drive of the game, which ended with a 33-yard field goal by Andy Borregales. Unfortunately for the Patriots, Drake Maye suffered an ankle injury on the play prior to the field goal and was unable to return, and the offense struggled to move down the field with backup Tommy DeVito under center. Maye will undergo more tests once the team has returned to home soil, but the good news for the Patriots is that they are on a bye for Week 11, so the third-year quarterback has more time to heal before New England's next game in Week 12 against the Chargers on Sunday, Nov. 29. Henry's two catches Sunday were his fewest since Week 3 against the Jaguars (one), and the veteran tight end has a 34-383-2 receiving line on 40 targets through 10 regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Hollins caught five of six targets for 48 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich.
injuries.longComment: In his second game back from a calf injury, Hollins led the Patriots in catches and receiving yards, but the entire offense was compromised when Drake Maye (ankle) was knocked out of the game early. A.J. Brown (hamstring) also didn't last long in his latest return to action. New England gets a bye in Week 11, giving the team's injured stars a chance to recover, so Hollins' role and usage may not become clear until after the break. Over six appearances this season, Hollins has produced a 23-293-1 line on 32 targets.

injuries.shortComment: Kiner carried the ball 10 times for 25 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to Detroit.
injuries.longComment: Rhamondre Stevenson was active despite dealing with a knee issue during the practice week, but the veteran back gained just four yards on six carries, and Kiner wound up leading the Patriots' backfield in both volume and yardage. The entire offense struggles after Drake Maye (ankle) was knocked out of the game early, however. New England gets a Week 11 bye, so Kiner's role and usage for a Week 12 clash with the Chargers likely won't become clear until the health of Stevenson and Maye come into focus after the break.

injuries.shortComment: Stevenson carried the ball six times for four yards and caught his only target for one yard in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich.
injuries.longComment: The whole Patriots' offense struggled after Drake Maye (ankle) was knocked out of the game early, but Stevenson also didn't look to be in peak form after dealing with a knee issue during the practice week. Corey Kiner wound up leading the backfield with just 25 rushing yards on 10 totes. Stevenson will get a Week 11 bye to rest up, and if Maye's injury ends up sidelining him for an extended period, New England could lean heavily on its running game in Week 12 against the Chargers.

injuries.shortComment: Jones (cramps) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Lions in Munich.
injuries.longComment: Jones left the game during the fourth quarter, and given the score of the contest, the veteran linebacker is unlikely to return to Sunday's game. If that's the case, then Jones will finish with two tackles (one solo) and one QB hit.

injuries.shortComment: Spillane (illness) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Lions in Munich.
injuries.longComment: Spillane went to the locker room in the third quarter, and he's being evaluated by medical staff to determine whether he can return to Sunday's international game. Darius Muasau has taken over for Spillane at inside linebacker.

injuries.shortComment: Sanker recorded seven tackles (four solo) including 1.0 sacks during Sunday's 21-13 loss at Chicago.
injuries.longComment: Sanker was able to wrap up Caleb Williams for the first sack of his career in Week 11, and he collected seven-plus tackles for the fifth time this year. He'll probably be spending more time in coverage against a pass-dependent Bengals offense in Week 12.

injuries.shortComment: Stutsman recorded nine tackles (three solo) and an interception during Sunday's 21-13 loss at Chicago.
injuries.longComment: Stutsman found himself in the right place at the right time when a Caleb Williams pass was batted into the air late in the second quarter, but the Saints weren't able to capitalize after starting in Bears territory. He also logged nine total tackles for a second straight game. His role in Week 12 against the Bengals will likely depend heavily on the status of Pete Werner (hamstring).

injuries.shortComment: Delp hauled in his lone target for a six-yard reception in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.
injuries.longComment: The rookie third-round pick out of Georgia has handled a muted role at tight end behind Juwan Johnson and Noah Fant this season, compiling five receptions for 26 yards on five targets through nine appearances. Delp was limited to just 21 of the Saints' 72 offensive snaps in Week 11, but he could see his playing time pick up if the hamstring injury that knocked Johnson out of Sunday's loss early prevents him from suiting up this coming weekend in Cincinnati.

injuries.shortComment: Elliss recorded five tackles (two solo) in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.
injuries.longComment: The five tackles were Elliss's fewest in a game this season, and it comes after back-to-back games of double-digit stops. Across seven appearances in 2026, Elliss has produced 61 tackles (31 solo), including 2.0 sacks, and two pass breakups on 100 percent of the defensive snaps in those seven contests.

injuries.shortComment: Lance failed to catch his only target and added 47 yards on kickoff returns during Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.
injuries.longComment: Lance was unable to reel in a deep pass from quarterback Tyler Shough in the first quarter, and he didn't get another look the rest of the game. The wide receiver was on the field for 21 offensive snaps, ranking fourth at his position behind Devaughn Vele (64), Chris Olave (62) and Jordyn Tyson (36) in the contest. Lance will continue to primarily serve as a special-teams asset for New Orleans moving forward, making him an unattractive option for fantasy managers.

injuries.shortComment: Donaldson logged a five-yard carry and brought in all four of his targets for 12 yards during the Saints' 21-13 loss to the Bears on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
injuries.longComment: Donaldson recorded season highs in both catches and targets, and he finished third on the Saints in both of those categories behind Chris Olave and Devaughn Vele. However, Donaldson coughed up the football on his first catch of the game early in the second quarter, which the Bears offense capitalized on with a six-play drive that ended with a three-yard touchdown pass from Caleb Williams to D'Andre Swift. Donaldson's 32 offensive snaps were tied with Travis Etienne for most among Saints running backs Sunday, although Etienne saw a heavier workload with 14 carries for 76 yards while Alvin Kamara, who played only eight offensive snaps, found the end zone on a one-yard touchdown pass from Tyler Shough in the second quarter. Losers of three of their last four games, the Saints will look to reverse their fortunes in Week 12 against the Bengals on Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Fant caught two of his five targets for 19 yards in the Saints' 21-13 loss to the Bears on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Fant played 49 offensive snaps in Sunday's contest. The starting tight end was on the field for 69 percent of the team's offensive plays but remains off the same page with quarterback Tyler Shough. The tight end's five targets are the most attention he has seen since Week 1 against the Lions.

injuries.shortComment: Saints head coach Kellen Moore said Monday that Johnson is still undergoing further medical evaluation after injuring his hamstring during Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears, Ross Jackson of WWL-TV reports.
injuries.longComment: The Saints expect to have a better feel for Johnson's status Wednesday, when the team holds its first practice of Week 12. Before exiting Sunday in the third quarter, Johnson was targeted just once and failed to record a reception for the second time in 10 appearances on the season. If the hamstring injury prevents Johnson from playing next weekend in Cincinnati, Noah Fant and Oscar Delp would be in line for added snaps at tight end.

injuries.shortComment: Smyth made two of three field-goal attempts and his lone PAT in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.
injuries.longComment: The Saints didn't have a scoring drive until the second quarter, when Smyth made his season-long, 56-yard field goal to cut the lead going into halftime, his first of two 50-plus-yard FGs in the game. The 25-year-old also continued his perfect PAT percentage for the season, making his singular attempt (5-for-5 in three games). His play on kickoffs stood out Sunday, committing two penalties for kicking the ball out of bounds and giving Chicago excellent field position.

injuries.shortComment: Kamara rushed one time for one yard and caught a one-yard touchdown on two targets in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.
injuries.longComment: The veteran running back played just eight of 72 offensive snaps, while both CJ Donaldson and Travis Etienne played 32 each with Audric Estime a healthy inactive. Kamara has touched the ball just seven times on 24 snaps over the past two weeks, but he's turned three of those touches into short touchdowns. The Saints' three-man backfield continues to be one to try and avoid when making fantasy lineup decisions. Kamara's proverbial gas tank is nearing empty, but the Saints continue to give him high-value touches near the goal line while refusing to play him outside of the red zone.

injuries.shortComment: Vele caught seven passes for 76 yards on seven targets in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.
injuries.longComment: Vele continues to run virtually every route for New Orleans, and the seven grabs matched his season high from Week 1 against the Lions, while Vele's 76 yards are a new high-water mark for the receiver. It was notable that Jordyn Tyson ran just 22 routes on Tyler Shough's 51 dropbacks against Chicago. The Saints offense has become tough to predict on a week-to-week basis. Vele is more of a low-ceiling fantasy WR4/5 most weeks.

injuries.shortComment: Tyson caught one of two targets for six yards and added four rushing yards on his only carry in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.
injuries.longComment: One week after logging 13 targets as Tyler Shough's top downfield option, Tyson all but disappeared as Chris Olave instead saw WR1-worthy volume. The Saints' aerial attack simply may not be able to support both wideouts in the same game, which would mark Tyson as a volatile, but high-ceiling, fantasy asset for the rest of the season. The rookie will try to bounce back in Week 12 against the Bengals.

injuries.shortComment: Etienne carried the ball 14 times for 76 yards and failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 21-13 loss to Chicago.
injuries.longComment: The former Jaguar was the clear No. 1 option in the backfield for the Saints. Alvin Kamara saw just two touches and CJ Donaldson handled five, although Kamara did vulture another red-zone TD on a one-yard reception in the second quarter, Most of Etienne's production came on a 46-yard scamper that saw him tackled just short of the goal line, setting up Kamara's score, but the fact that he was able to produce his first big play as a Saint was still encouraging. Etienne will attempt to build on this performance in Week 12 against the Bengals.

injuries.shortComment: Shough completed 25 of 42 passes for 222 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears. He added 34 rushing yards on three carries.
injuries.longComment: Despite the high volume of attempts, Shough couldn't get much going through the air while dealing with a ferocious Chicago pass rush that sacked him six times, including one for a fourth-quarter safety by Montez Sweat. Shough has gone four straight games without producing multiple TDs, posting a 4:3 TD:INT over that stretch while completing 67.3 percent of his passes with a weak 6.3 YPA. The second-year QB will likely need to be a lot more productive in Week 12 if the Saints are going to keep up with Joe Burrow and the Bengals.

injuries.shortComment: Olave caught nine of 15 targets for 102 yards in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.
injuries.longComment: One week after taking a back seat to rookie Jordyn Tyson, Olave re-emerged as Tyler Shough's favorite downfield option, as he set a new season high in targets and topped 100 receiving yards for the fourth time in 2026. Tyson, meanwhile, caught only one pass on two targets, suggesting the Saints' aerial attack may not be able to support both wideouts in the same game. Olave will look to make an impact again in Week 12 against the Bengals.

injuries.shortComment: Wilson (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Saints' emergency third quarterback against the Bears on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: As the emergency QB3, Wilson is not allowed to play Sunday unless starter Tyler Shough and backup Spencer Rattler both leave the game due to injury, illness or ejection. Wilson has yet to appear in a regular-season game in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: Estime (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Bears.
injuries.longComment: Estime's role in the offense was reduced in Week 10 against the Panthers, which marked Travis Etienne's return from a five-game absence due to a hamstring injury. Estime is a healthy scratch for Sunday's game, which means Alvin Kamara and CJ Donaldson will operate as the rotational options out of the backfield behind Etienne. Estime's next opportunity to play is Week 12 against the Bengals on Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Carter recorded four total tackles (three solo), including 2.0 sacks, during Sunday's 23-18 win over the Jaguars.
injuries.longComment: Carter was able to notch his first career multi-sack performance, getting to Jaguars quarterback Trevor Lawrence in both the first and second quarters. The edge rusher registered 12 total pressures in the contest according to NFL Next Gen Stats, and he has now compiled 26 total tackles (10 solo), including 4.0 sacks, while also adding a forced fumble over 10 games so far during the 2026 season.

injuries.shortComment: Banks recorded six total tackles (five solo) and three passes defensed, including an interception, during Sunday's 23-18 win over the Jaguars.
injuries.longComment: Banks matched his season high in tackles while he was able to secure his second interception of the season, jumping in front of a short pass from Jaguars quarterback Trevor Lawrence in the first quarter. The cornerback has now registered 33 total tackles (21 solo) and a career-high 14 passes defensed, including two interceptions, while also scoring a defensive touchdown over eight contests so far during the 2026 campaign.

injuries.shortComment: The Giants signed Smoot off the practice squad to the active roster Tuesday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Smoot was elevated from the practice squad to the active roster for three consecutive weeks between Weeks 9 and 11 and accumulated three tackles (one solo), including 1.0 sacks, in that span. Now that he's on the active roster, Smoot will be available for the Giants for the rest of the season while serving as in a rotational role at the edge rusher position behind Abdul Carter and Kayvon Thibodeaux.

injuries.shortComment: The Giants placed Newsome (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Newsome is expected to undergo surgery for a sprained ankle that he sustained in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday. Now that he's on IR, Newsome will be required to miss at least the next four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 16 against the Lions on Monday, Dec. 28. Paulson Adebo is expected to start opposite Deonte Banks at outside cornerback in Newsome's absence.

injuries.shortComment: McFadden recorded seven tackles (three solo) in Sunday's 23-18 win over the Jaguars.
injuries.longComment: With Tremaine Edmunds (chest) done for the season, McFadden has started each of the last four games as an every-down linebacker. During that span, he's piled up 36 tackles (23 solo), including 1.0 sacks, and a fumble recovery.

injuries.shortComment: Reese recorded seven tackles (four solo) in Sunday's 23-18 win over the Jaguars.
injuries.longComment: The seven tackles were the third-lowest total for Reese in a game this season, and he did nothing else in the box score against Jacksonville. Reese is up to 88 tackles (57 solo), including 4.5 sacks, four pass breakups, including an interception, one forced fumble and a fumble recovery across 10 starts in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: Singletary finished with one carry for five yards and one catch for five yards in Sunday's 23-18 win over the Jaguars.
injuries.longComment: The running back played just 10 offensive snaps behind starter Cam Skattebo. Singletary has averaged just 2.9 yards per carry this year on 41 attempts.

injuries.shortComment: Mooney did not catch any of his five targets during Sunday's 23-18 win versus the Jaguars.
injuries.longComment: Quarterback J.J. McCarthy was inefficient against a solid Jaguars defense in Week 11, completing just 18 of his 38 pass attempts for 173 yards. A couple of those 20 incompletions were intended for an open Mooney, who continued to operate in the deeper areas of the field. He'll keep hunting for a big play in Week 12 at Indianapolis.

injuries.shortComment: Johnson caught his only target for 15 yards during Sunday's 23-18 win versus the Jaguars.
injuries.longComment: Johnson was third in offensive snaps (14) among Giants tight ends Sunday behind starter Isaiah Likely (49) and veteran Chris Manhertz (19). With that said, Johnson did manage to record at least one catch for the fourth time in his last five games. As long as Likely remains available, though, Johnson will remain in a rotational role.

injuries.shortComment: Fields caught two of his five targets for 25 yards in the Giants' 23-15 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Fields played 56 offensive snaps in the contest, logging 86 percent of the Giants' such plays. Despite the lack of catches, the No. 2 wide receiver continues to receive attention from quarterback J.J. McCarthy on a week-to-week basis.

injuries.shortComment: Zvada made three of four field-goal attempts and both PATs in Sunday's 23-18 win over the Jaguars.
injuries.longComment: The rookie kicker continues to have his ups and downs. While he was good from 53, 54 and 43 yards, Zvada missed a chip shot from 32 yards on the opening drive of the second half that left coach John Harbaugh shaking his head. Zvada continues to be a bit of a liability, as he's made just 11 of 18 field-goal attempts over his last six games. Harbaugh is clearly growing more frustrated by the week, and it could lead to the Giants making a move at the position.

injuries.shortComment: McCarthy completed 18 of 38 passes for 173 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions and rushed seven times for 33 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: McCarthy had his share of trouble against an aggressive Jaguars defense, leading to a season-worst 47.4 percent completion rate. However, the emerging signal-caller avoided turnovers and connected with Malik Nabers for an eight-yard touchdown pass in the second quarter. McCarthy also provided some timely contributions with his legs, and he's averaging 5.4 yards on his 22 rush attempts to date. McCarthy connected with nine different targets overall as he continues to show good command of the offense, and he'll look to bounce back efficiency-wise in a Week 12 road matchup against the Colts next Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Likely brought in one of three targets for 35 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Likely finished with season lows in reception and targets, although he did provide an impressive gain on his one catch. The breakout tight end was coming off a season-best 127-yard tally against the Commanders in Week 10, so Sunday's scant involvement can be described as an outlier. Despite the unremarkable performance, Likely still boasts a career-best 56-610-7 line across 10 games heading into a Week 12 road clash against the Colts next Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Skattebo rushed 14 times for 34 yards and brought in three of seven targets for 14 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
injuries.longComment: Skattebo was unsurprisingly stymied on the ground by the Jaguars' elite run defense, and he couldn't really make up for it with his work through the air. Skattebo also committed another untimely turnover, fumbling at Jacksonville's 31-yard line with just over four minutes remaining in the third quarter and New York trying to add to a 20-6 lead. The change of possession ultimately didn't lead to any Jaguars points, however, and head coach John Harbaugh showed some faith in the second-year back by affording him the opportunity to ice the upset win with three carries on the final drive. Skattebo proved up to the task by netting 13 yards on those touches to force the Jags to exhaust their timeouts, and he should continue helming the backfield in a Week 12 road matchup against the Colts next Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Nabers brought in seven of 12 targets for 55 yards and a touchdown in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Nabers was in the familiar position of leading the Giants across the board in receptions, receiving yards and targets, and the third-year star also snapped a four-game touchdown drought with an eight-yard grab in the second quarter. Nabers has at least five catches in eight straight contests and three double-digit target tallies within that span, and the 2024 first-round pick should continue to be the subject of plenty of J.J. McCarthy's attention in a Week 12 road matchup against the Colts next Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Harrison (groin) was a full participant at practice Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Harrison missed the Giants' contest versus the Commanders in Week 10 because of a groin injury, but it appears he'll be able to return to game action in Week 11. Of his 141 total snaps so far in 2026, 136 have come on special teams.

injuries.shortComment: Tracy (hamstring) could be reinstated from injured reserve when first eligible ahead of the Giants' Week 13 game against the 49ers, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: The Giants haven't provided any updates on Tracy since he landed on IR on Oct. 27 after sustaining a hamstring strain in a Week 7 win over the Texans, but the running back is seemingly progressing well and could be ready to play once he sits out the required four games. Once he's reinstated, Tracy could operate as a change-of-pace option behind Cam Skattebo, who appears to have reclaimed the lead role out of the New York backfield after a one-game benching in Week 6.

injuries.shortComment: Winston carried twice for one yard in Thursday's 24-21 loss to the Commanders.
injuries.longComment: J.J. McCarthy made his third consecutive start for the Giants, but Winston continued to get sprinkled into the game plan during short-yardage situations. He extended a second-quarter drive that culminated in a Cam Skattebo touchdown by gaining a yard on a fourth-and-one play, but Winston was dropped for no gain on a third-and-one run in the fourth quarter that resulted in a Giants punt. The Giants may continue to turn to Winston for quarterback sneaks in future weeks in an effort to limit the wear and tear on McCarthy.

injuries.shortComment: Davis registered six tackles (four solo) during Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: It was the second consecutive week in which Davis posted six stops, and he finished Sunday's game tied for the second-most tackles on the Jets behind Jamien Sherwood (11). Davis is up to 74 total tackles through 11 regular-season games, and the 2012 third-rounder is well on pace to record his 10th-straight 100-tackle season.

injuries.shortComment: Belton posted six tackles (one solo) during the Jets' 27-24 win over the Chargers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Belton played every single defensive snap Sunday and finished tied for the second-most tackles on the Jets behind Jamien Sherwood (11). Belton has recorded at least six stop in 10 of 11 regular-season games and is up to 88 tackles (42 solo), including 1.0 sacks, and five pass defenses. He is well on his way to cracking the tackling century mark for a second consecutive season.

injuries.shortComment: Bailey recorded five tackles (two solo), including 2.0 sacks, one pass defense and one forced fumble during the Jets' 27-24 win over the Chargers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Week 11 was the third multi-sack performance of the season for Bailey, and his first takedown of Justin Herbert early in the second quarter resulted in a fumble that the Chargers recovered. Bailey is up to 9.5 sacks through 10 regular-season games, which leads all  rookies and is tied for third-most in the NFL behind Will Anderson (11.5) and Greg Rousseau (10.0). Bailey also leads the league with six forced fumbles, and the Texas Tech product is living up to his pedigree as the second-overall pick of the 2026 NFL Draft.

injuries.shortComment: Sherwood recorded 11 tackles (eight solo) and a forced fumble in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
injuries.longComment: It was the linebacker's fourth game this season with double-digit tackles. He also had a fourth-quarter sack wiped off the board by a Jets penalty. Through 11 games this season, Sherwood has recorded 97 tackles (49 solo), four pass breakups, three forced fumbles and a fumble recovery on 97 percent of the defensive snaps.

injuries.shortComment: Shepard reverted to the Jets' practice squad Monday.
injuries.longComment: Shepard was elevated for Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers due to the absences of fellow wideouts Omar Cooper (ankle) and Isaiah Williams (ribs). The veteran receiver answered the call by hauling in both of his targets for 24 yards and two touchdowns in the win. Since Shepard has now been elevated the maximum three times, he'll need to be signed to the 53-man roster in order to suit up again for the Jets this season.

injuries.shortComment: Sanders made both of his field-goal attempts and all three PATs in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
injuries.longComment: Sanders got the scoring started with a 50-yard field goal to cap the opening drive of the game. He later made one from 24 yards in the third quarter. Sanders has been a bright spot for the Jets this season, as he entered play Sunday leading the league in field-goal attempts (28) and makes (25), and he further boosted his conversion rate. The Jets have struggled to turn red-zone possessions into touchdowns this season, making Sanders a valuable fantasy kicker.

injuries.shortComment: Taylor caught two passes for 25 yards on two targets in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
injuries.longComment: The Jets controlled this game from start to finish and never trailed, so Geno Smith attempted just 21 passes to 37 run plays for New York. Taylor's 25 yards were his most in a game since Week 7, and he's totaled just 10 catches for 75 yards and no touchdowns over his last four contests. He's a very risky play as a fantasy tight end.

injuries.shortComment: Davis didn't play an offensive snap in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
injuries.longComment: As has been the case for three straight weeks, with Breece Hall back healthy, Davis has been glued to special teams for the Jets. He has no fantasy appeal.

injuries.shortComment: Sadiq caught all three of his targets for 30 yards during Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
injuries.longComment: Sadiq finished tied for second on the team in targets with wide receiver Adonai Mitchell and running back Breece Hall behind wideout Garrett Wilson (five). The tight end was able to reel in multiple passes for just the second time since catching seven of eight targets for 105 yards and a score in Week 3 against the Lions. Sadiq has now caught 25 of 36 targets for 268 yards and a score while adding a three-yard rushing touchdown over the first 11 regular-season contests of his career.

injuries.shortComment: Mitchell caught two passes for 30 yards on three targets in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
injuries.longComment: Even with Omar Cooper (ankle) and Isaiah Williams (ribs) inactive, Mitchell's role didn't change, as his three targets tied with two other teammates for second on the team behind Garrett Wilson's five on a day the Jets called 37 run plays to just 22 passes. Mitchell has just one touchdown this season and has only 14 catches for 212 yards and no touchdowns in six games surrounding his 7-142-1 receiving performance from Week 8 against the Raiders. He's a big-play specialist in an offense that prefers to feed Wilson and its running backs.

injuries.shortComment: Allen rushed 16 times for 75 yards while catching his lone target for nine yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
injuries.longComment: Allen's 16 carries matched his total from the previous two games combined, as he had seen a downtick in opportunities since fellow RB Breece Hall returned from a quadriceps injury. Hall led the backfield once again with 100 scrimmage yards and a touchdown on 23 touches, but Allen was a key part of the game plan as well in the run-heavy win. The Jets will face a one-win team for a second consecutive game in Week 12 at Miami, which could allow Allen to stay involved alongside Hall.

injuries.shortComment: Smith completed 17 of 21 passes for 176 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers. He also rushed once for four yards.
injuries.longComment: Smith didn't have a completion longer than 21 yards but kept the offense on schedule with an accurate performance. Most importantly, he stepped up in the red zone, which has been the team's Achilles' heel throughout the season. Smith threw a seven-yard touchdown pass to Breece Hall to snap the Jets' two-game touchdown drought in the second quarter, then tacked on touchdown passes of eight and 15 yards to practice-squad elevation Sterling Shepard. The veteran QB will take a 15:3 TD:INT into a Week 12 road game against the Dolphins, who defeated the Jets in Week 7 despite three touchdown passes from Smith.

injuries.shortComment: Wilson caught three of five targets for 39 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
injuries.longComment: Wilson led the team in receiving yards and targets as Geno Smith threw for just 176 yards, though Wilson wasn't on the receiving end of any of Smith's three touchdown passes. The Jets' No. 1 wideout hasn't scored since Week 5, and Wilson has fallen short of 45 receiving yards four times this season, though he has also topped 100 yards three times. Wilson will face a Dolphins defense in Week 12 that held him to a season-low 26 receiving yards in their Week 7 meeting.

injuries.shortComment: Hall rushed 20 times for 86 yards while catching all three of his targets for 14 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
injuries.longComment: Hall reached 100 scrimmage yards for the second consecutive game while scoring his first touchdown since Week 1 on a seven-yard reception in the second quarter. Both Hall and Braelon Allen (17 touches for 84 yards) were heavily involved as the Jets snapped a five-game losing streak and were able to stick with the ground game. Hall has 56 touches to Allen's 36 in three games since the former returned from a quadriceps injury. After dropping the Chargers to 1-9 with Sunday's win, Hall and the Jets will face the 1-9 Dolphins in Week 12.

injuries.shortComment: Parham (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Amanda Vogt of the Jets' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Parham, who is working through a knee issue, has been given the green light to play Sunday after going through pregame warmups. He'll start at left guard while Jordan Meredith provides depth at the position.

injuries.shortComment: Phillips (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Amanda Vogt of the Jets' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Phillips played through an ankle issue against the Bills in Week 10, and the veteran defensive tackle has been cleared to suit up for Sunday's contest. He has accumulated 36 tackles (11 solo) and one fumble recovery through 10 regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Onyemata (abdomen) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.
injuries.longComment: Onyemata was designated to return from injured reserve Wednesday and strung together three consecutive limited practice sessions. However, the veteran defensive tackle is not quite ready to come off IR, so his next chance to play is Week 12 against the Dolphins on Sunday, Nov. 29. Onyemata has not played since Week 2 against the Packers due to an abdominal injury.

injuries.shortComment: Ebiketie (oblique) was estimated as a non-participant on the Eagles' injury report Tuesday.
injuries.longComment: It seems like Ebiketie might have suffered the injury during Sunday's game versus the Steelers. Regardless, his availability for Philadelphia's game against the Cowboys on Thanksgiving is now in question. If he's unable to practice Wednesday, his odds of playing Thursday will probably be low.

injuries.shortComment: Mitchell (hamstring) was a limited participant in Tuesday's walkthrough practice.
injuries.longComment: Mitchell injured his left hamstring during the Eagles' 19-16 win over the Steelers on Sunday. He was held out of Monday's walkthrough practice but was back on the field in a limited capacity Tuesday, and defensive coordinator Vic Fangio told reporters that Mitchell should "be fine" to face the Cowboys on Thanksgiving Day. Riq Woolen would be in line for more defensive snaps in the event that Mitchell cannot play Thursday.

injuries.shortComment: Shipley (foot/illness) was a limited participant at the Eagles' walkthrough practice Tuesday.
injuries.longComment: Shipley remained limited for a second day in a row while dealing with an illness and a foot injury. The running back returned to action in Week 11 after missing four games with a foot injury, and the illness is likely the more substantial concern at the moment. Shipley will have one more chance to be a full participant at Wednesday's final session ahead of Thursday's matchup with the Cowboys.

injuries.shortComment: McKee (ribs) was a full participant at the Eagles' walkthrough practice Tuesday.
injuries.longComment: McKee was estimated to be a limited participant on Monday's injury report due to an injury to his ribs. He now looks to be all set to serve as the team's primary reserve option at quarterback behind starter Joe Milton on Thursday against the Cowboys.

injuries.shortComment: The Eagles listed Goedert (shin) as a full participant in Tuesday's walkthrough practice.
injuries.longComment: Philadelphia deemed Goedert a limited participant on Monday's estimated injury report, but had the team held a traditional practice Tuesday, the veteran tight end would have been able to increase his activity. Goedert thus looks on track to play Thursday, when he'll face off against a Cowboys defense that he burned for five receptions for 48 yards on seven targets back in Week 7.

injuries.shortComment: The Eagles listed Barkley (neck/illness) as a full participant in Tuesday's walkthrough practice.
injuries.longComment: Though Tuesday's injury report was merely an estimate, Barkley would have been able to take every rep had the Eagles held a traditional practice session. Barkley emerged from this past Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers with a neck injury and an illness, but neither health concern looks like it will prevent him from playing Thursday in Dallas.

injuries.shortComment: questionable
injuries.longComment: questionable

injuries.shortComment: Young tallied four tackles (two solo), including 2.0 sacks, during Philadelphia's win over the Steelers on Sunday
injuries.longComment: Young had a productive outing in the victory, logging his first two sacks of the campaign. The 26-year-old will look to build on this strong performance and keep producing during the Week 12 matchup against the Cowboys.

injuries.shortComment: Trotter logged 13 tackles (nine solo) during Philadelphia's win over the Steelers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Trotter had a strong outing in the win, leading the team in tackles while playing every defensive snap. The 23-year-old has now tallied double-digit tackles in three straight games and will look to keep producing during Thursday's matchup versus the Cowboys.

injuries.shortComment: Blue returned his lone kickoff for 23 yards but fumbled the ball in the process during the Eagles' 19-16 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: The loose ball was recovered by the Steelers, and Pittsburgh's offense turned that takeaway into a 40-yard field goal by Chris Boswell four plays later. It ended up being the only touch of the game for Blue, who played all 11 of his snaps on special teams. There's an outside chance he sees some involvement on offense against the Cowboys on Thanksgiving Day, but that will depend on the availability of both Saquon Barkley (neck/illness) and Will Shipley (foot/illness).

injuries.shortComment: Stowers didn't log any offensive snaps in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
injuries.longComment: Dallas Goedert (47 snaps), Johnny Mundt (eight) and Zach Ertz (six) handled tight-end duties for Philly, while Stowers played 20 snaps on special teams. The rookie tight end is miles from fantasy relevance this season.

injuries.shortComment: Cooper caught four of his five targets for 59 yards in the Eagles' 19-16 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Cooper played 46 offensive snaps and 15 special-teams snaps in Sunday's contest. The wide receiver continues to see a significant snap share for the Eagles, drawing two more targets than rookie first-round pick Makai Lemon in the Week 11 win.

injuries.shortComment: Jones (ankle) was estimated as a DNP on Monday's injury report.
injuries.longComment: Jones suffered an ankle injury during the Eagles' 19-16 win over the Steelers on Sunday. Philadelphia didn't hold practice Monday, so his participation over the next two sessions will shed light on his chances of playing against Dallas on Thanksgiving Day. Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) was also injured in Week 11, so the Eagles could very well have Riq Woolen and Kelee Ringo as the outside cornerbacks against a Cowboys offense that scored seven touchdowns (four passing, three rushing) in a 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Elliott went 4-for-4 on field-goal attempts and made his lone PAT in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
injuries.longComment: The Eagles kicker accounted for 13 of the team's 19 points, as he was good from 41, 29, 53 and 55 yards on his field goals. It was Elliott's first game with multiple field goals made since Week 4 against the Rams. That's how broken the Philadelphia offense has been for an extended period, and it doesn't project to get any better moving forward with Joe Milton at the controls. Elliott will be a hold-your-nose fantasy play in a theoretically high-scoring environment Thursday against the Cowboys, but it will be a movable force against a stoppable object when the Dallas defense squares off with the Eagles offense.

injuries.shortComment: Lemon caught one of three targets for three yards in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
injuries.longComment: Lemon turned three targets into just three yards while DeVonta Smith (hamstring) paced the Eagles with 12 targets in the latter's return. In five games playing alongside Smith, Lemon has just 11 catches for 60 yards. Opportunities should be available against Dallas' porous secondary on Thanksgiving, but it remains to be seen if the unproven QB-WR combo of Joe Milton and Lemon can capitalize on that favorable matchup.

injuries.shortComment: Milton completed 11 of 21 passes for 141 yards while rushing five times for seven yards in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
injuries.longComment: Milton has thrown for just 310 yards without a touchdown pass or interception through two starts. He rushed for just seven yards Sunday after notching 64 rushing yards against the Giants in his first start with the Eagles, but Milton avoided mistakes as the Eagles rode their defense and Saquon Barkley's legs to their third win of the season. Twelve of Milton's 21 passes were directed to DeVonta Smith (hamstring) in their first game together. Milton is poised to start on Thanksgiving against the Cowboys, with whom he appeared in four games last season. He was on Dallas' practice squad prior to signing with the Eagles in October.

injuries.shortComment: Smith (hamstring) caught five of 12 targets for 41 yards in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
injuries.longComment: Smith was targeted on 12 of Joe Milton's 21 passes in the wide receiver's first game since Week 6. Milton has thrown for just 310 yards without a touchdown pass through two starts for the Eagles, so expectations should be tempered for the team's passing game as a whole, but Smith has reclaimed his role as the team's top pass catcher. Smith could make the most of his hefty target share Thursday against the generous Dallas secondary.

injuries.shortComment: Payton (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Eagles' emergency third quarterback against the Steelers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: As the emergency third quarterback, Payton is not allowed to play Sunday unless both starter Joe Milton and backup Tanner McKee are taken out of the game due to injury, illness or ejection.

injuries.shortComment: Carter (quadriceps) is active for Sunday's game against the Steelers.
injuries.longComment: Carter informed the Eagles' medical staff while he was traveling to the stadium Sunday that his quadriceps was bothering him. The fifth-year defensive tackle has been cleared to suit up, but if he plays under a snap count or is available only as an emergency option, then Ty Robinson and Gabe Hall would be poised to take on larger roles on defense.

injuries.shortComment: Baun (back) was placed on the Eagles' injured reserve Saturday.
injuries.longComment: Baun was held out of practice all week due to a back injury that he sustained against the Giants in Week 9. The injury is severe enough for him to require a stint on IR, which means he'll miss at least the next four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 15 against the Seahawks. Jeremiah Trotter figures to start alongside Jihaad Campbell at inside linebacker moving forward, beginning with Sunday's home tilt against the Steelers.

injuries.shortComment: The Eagles placed Wicks (ankle/foot) on injured reserve Saturday.
injuries.longComment: Wicks missed the three games before the Eagles' Week 10 bye due to an ankle injury, and he was limited during Week 11 prep before the team tacked on a foot issue on Friday's practice report, after which he was ruled out for Sunday's contest against the Steelers. Per Tim McManus of ESPN.com, Wicks sustained the foot injury Friday, and it presumably led to his placement on IR. Wicks will be sidelined until at least Philadelphia's Week 15 matchup with Seattle on Saturday, Dec. 19.

injuries.shortComment: Carter (abdomen) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Steelers.
injuries.longComment: An abdominal injury prevented Carter from playing in Week 9 against the Giants. He had extra rest thanks to the Week 10 bye, and his full practice Friday was enough for him to avoid an injury tag for Sunday's contest. Carter's return gives the Eagles a boost in the secondary and another contributor on special teams.

injuries.shortComment: Smith (illness) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against Pittsburgh.
injuries.longComment: An illness limited Smith's practice reps both Wednesday and Thursday, but he was a full participant in Friday's session, which was enough for him to avoid an injury tag for Sunday's contest. The fourth-year edge rusher has 17 tackles (nine solo), including 5.0 sacks, and one pass defense across eight regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Rudolph will start Friday's game against the Broncos, Tom Pelissero of The Ringer and Netflix reports.
injuries.longComment: In a stunning move late Tuesday night, the Steelers benched Aaron Rodgers following two straight losses to the Bengals and Eagles, where the offense didn't play well at all, as Rodgers averaged a paltry 5.1 yards per attempt. The Steelers will see if Rudolph can provide a spark for 6-4 Pittsburgh. Rudolph has made 19 career regular-season starts and has averaged 6.6 yards per attempt with a 30:22 TD:INT on 742 pass attempts.

injuries.shortComment: Rodgers has been benched by the Steelers, and Mason Rudolph will start Friday's game against the Broncos, Tom Pelissero of The Ringer and Netflix reports.
injuries.longComment: Additionally, Rodgers will be inactive against Denver. It's a stunning late Tuesday night announcement, but the Steelers' playoff chances have taken a hit following back-to-back losses to the Bengals and Eagles, dropping Pittsburgh to 6-4 on the season. Rodgers has been particularly dreadful in both games, completing 45 of 73 passes for 370 yards (5.1 YPA) and three touchdowns. Losing to an Eagles team that was starting Joe Milton proved to be the final straw for coach Mike McCarthy, who will turn things over to Rudolph. Rodgers has already stated that 2026 is his final NFL season. If he's unable to get the job back from Rudolph, there's a chance Rodgers has made his final start.

injuries.shortComment: Dunker (knee) logged a full practice Tuesday.
injuries.longComment: Dunker has put together four consecutive full sessions since being designated to return from injured reserve this past Wednesday. The rookie third-rounder is in the final stages of his recovery from an MCL sprain that he sustained in September. Dunker would need to be activated from IR in order to be available for Friday's game against the Broncos.

injuries.shortComment: Ramsey recorded one solo tackle and a pass defensed during Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: Ramsey matched his season low in takedowns, but he was able to notch his first pass defensed since Week 5. The 32-year-old will have a chance to bounce back on a short week, taking on the Broncos on Friday at home.

injuries.shortComment: Queen recorded four total tackles (three solo) during Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: Queen entered Week 11 having notched double-digit tackles in three straight games, but his streak was snapped versus Philadelphia. The linebacker has now compiled 78 total tackles (28 solo), including 3.5 sacks, four passes defensed, one of which is an interception, and a forced fumble over 10 contests so far during the 2026 season.

injuries.shortComment: Herbig (hip) was limited in practice Tuesday.
injuries.longComment: Herbig upgraded his DNP practice status from last week to limited participation Tuesday. The 25-year-old missed Week 11 due to a hip injury. He has two more practice sessions to increase his chances of playing Friday against the Broncos.

injuries.shortComment: Skowronek (calf) did not practice Tuesday.
injuries.longComment: The 29-year-old appears to have suffered a setback with his calf injury, as he opened Week 12 as a non-participant in practice Tuesday. Skowronek missed the Steelers' last three games due to the same injury. He will likely need to upgrade his practice status for a chance to play Friday against the Broncos.

injuries.shortComment: Pittman (foot) was listed as a full participant in Tuesday's walkthrough practice.
injuries.longComment: The Steelers haven't yet brought Pittman back from injured reserve, but he stands a good chance at being activated for Friday's game against the Broncos. Pittman was listed as a full participant Tuesday on a third consecutive practice report as he works to regain conditioning after missing the Steelers' last six games.

injuries.shortComment: Wilson recorded just three tackles (one solo) and a pass breakup in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: One week after piling up 19 tackles (nine solo) in a loss to the Bengals, Wilson's three tackles Sunday were his fewest in a game this season. His 83 percent snap share on defense was also his lowest since Week 4. Wilson will be in position to rebound against Denver on Friday. He has 91 tackles (46 solo), including 1.0 sacks, four pass breakups, including an interception, and a fumble recovery across 10 games this season.

injuries.shortComment: Wilson caught three of six targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: It was Wilson's first game since suffering a finger injury in Week 5 that landed him on injured reserve. He ended up playing 49 of 71 offensive snaps, 39 of which came out wide. Wilson had primarily operated as the Steelers' slot receiver prior to his injury, but Germie Bernard has emerged in that role for Pittsburgh. While Michael Pittman (foot) is expected back for Friday's game against the Broncos, DK Metcalf might receive some form of team-imposed discipline after he had an on-field meltdown against the Eagles before being ejected from the game.

injuries.shortComment: Bernard caught six passes for 40 yards on 10 targets in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: With Michael Pittman (foot) remaining sidelined for Week 11, Bernard retained his every-down role on offense, playing 67 of 71 offensive snaps while leading the team in routes (52) and targets. It was a nice bounce-back game for the rookie after he was held without a catch on three targets against the Bengals in Week 10. Pittman is expected back for Friday's game against the Broncos, but Bernard could keep pacing the team in playing time, especially if DK Metcalf gets disciplined for his latest on-field outburst.

injuries.shortComment: Hurleman reverted to the Steelers' practice squad Monday.
injuries.longComment: With DK Metcalf ejected in the second half of Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles, Hurleman ended up playing 22 of 71 offensive snaps after getting bumped up from the practice squad to make his NFL debut. The  25-year-old saw seven targets, finishing with six receptions for 61 yards and the Steelers' lone touchdown of the contest. He also displaced Kaden Wetjen on the Steelers' return units, bringing back two kickoffs for 32 yards and three punts for 36 yards. Expect Hurleman to get elevated from the practice squad again in Friday's game against the Broncos.

injuries.shortComment: Metcalf won't receive a suspension after he was ejected from Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles, but the NFL is still reviewing discipline for the receiver that could include a fine, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
injuries.longComment: Metcalf was disqualified with 4:53 remaining in the third quarter Sunday after he attempted to poke Eagles defensive back Cooper DeJean in the eye. He was flagged for unsportsmanlike conduct in what was his second major transgression of the game; Metcalf previously drew an unnecessary roughness penalty in the first half, when he held his block of DeJean well after a play had finished. Though Metcalf won't miss further game action as a result of his ejection, he may have already lost the faith of his fantasy managers heading into a Week 12 matchup with the Broncos on Friday. Metcalf has hauled in just 36 of his 74 targets (48.6 percent catch rate) and has scored just two touchdowns on the season while topping 60 receiving yards in only two of his 10 appearances.

injuries.shortComment: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy suggested Monday that Highsmith (ankle) is likely to be sidelined for Friday's game against the Broncos, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports. "It's going to be tough for him to make it this week," McCarthy said.
injuries.longComment: Highsmith recorded a pair of sacks across just six snaps before he was forced out in the first quarter of Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles due to the ankle injury. Per Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com, the Steelers' initial belief is that Highsmith's ankle injury isn't serious, but the edge rusher will nonetheless have difficulty getting clearance to play on a short week. If healthy, Nick Herbig (hip/ribs) -- who was inactive for Week 11 -- will be the most likely candidate to start in place of Highsmith on Friday.

injuries.shortComment: Boswell went 3-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made his lone PAT in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: This was a battle of Pennsylvania's kickers, as Boswell and Jake Elliott combined to account for 23 of the game's 35 points. Boswell was good from 25, 40 and 52 yards. The veteran kicker has been trending downward the last two seasons, and he entered play Sunday having made just 79.2 percent of his field-goal tries this season. After his perfect showing against the Eagles, Boswell has made all of his field goals in back-to-back games for the first time all season. On the year, he's 22-for-27 on FGAs and a perfect 18-for-18 on PATs.

injuries.shortComment: Washington caught all three targets for 22 yards in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: The big tight end earned just a 6.8 percent target share on a day when Aaron Rodgers fired off 44 pass attempts in prolonged comeback mode. Washington has been held to 25 yards or fewer in eight of 10 games this season. He doesn't see enough volume to warrant weekly fantasy consideration as a touchdown-or-bust bet.

injuries.shortComment: Freiermuth caught all five of his targets for 39 yards during Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: Freiermuth matched his season high in catches, securing five passes in a game for the third time this year. The tight end has yet to exceed 50 receiving yards in a contest this season, and he entered Week 11 with exactly two catches in each of the team's last four games. Freiermuth has now caught 32 of 43 targets for 309 yards and five touchdowns while also adding four rushes for five yards and a score over 10 contests so far during the 2026 season.

injuries.shortComment: Dowdle rushed five times for 15 yards and caught four of five targets for 19 yards in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: Dowdle finished with 34 scrimmage yards for a second consecutive game after racking up 235 scrimmage yards over his preceding four appearances. He had five more yards than Jaylen Warren on two fewer touches in Sunday's loss. Dowdle is poised to retain his spot as the 1B option alongside Warren in Friday's Week 12 home game against the Broncos.

injuries.shortComment: Warren rushed nine times for 28 yards and caught two of three targets for one yard in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: Warren finished with 29 yards on 11 touches compared to 34 yards on nine touches for Rico Dowdle, as Pittsburgh's backfield duo was held quiet for a second consecutive game. After recording at least 73 scrimmage yards in eight consecutive games to start the season, Warren has produced just 75 yards without a touchdown over the past two games. Warren and Dowdle should continue to split backfield touches Friday against the Broncos.

injuries.shortComment: Wetjen (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: Wetjen has operated as the Steelers' top returner on both kickoffs and punts this season. However, with Roman Wilson back from injured reserve and Max Hurleman elevated from the practice squad to the active roster, Wetjen will be a healthy scratch Sunday for the first time this season. Wetjen's next opportunity to play is Friday against the Broncos, although the rookie fourth-rounder's chances of suiting up for that contest would be further diminished if Michael Pittman (foot) is activated from IR before that game.

injuries.shortComment: Elliott (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: Elliott did not play in Week 10 against the Bengals due to a knee injury he sustained during pregame warmups. He drew the questionable tag for Week 11 after logging full practices Thursday and Friday, and he's been cleared by medical staff to play Sunday. Elliott's return means Robert Spears-Jennings will revert to a rotational role in the secondary.

injuries.shortComment: Brown recorded four tackles (three solo) and a pick-six during the 49ers' 35-10 win over the Vikings on Sunday in Mexico City.
injuries.longComment: Brown picked off a pass from Kirk Cousins intended for Tai Felton late in the second quarter, which Brown returned 18 yards to the house to extend the 49ers' lead to 28-10. It was his first interception of 2026 and sixth of his career, and Brown is up to 55 tackles (31 solo) and four pass defenses through 10 regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: questionable
injuries.longComment: questionable

injuries.shortComment: questionable
injuries.longComment: questionable

injuries.shortComment: Warner recorded eight tackles (four solo) and a pass breakup in Sunday night's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: The four-time First-Team All-Pro linebacker has double-digit tackles in five of 10 games this season and is up to 96 tackles (42 solo), including 0.5 sacks, five forced fumbles, four pass breakups and a fumble recovery on 96 percent of the Niners' defensive snaps.

injuries.shortComment: Cowing returned one punt for no gain during San Francisco's win over the Vikings on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Cowing saw limited action in the win, playing just six snaps on offense and two on special teams. The 25-year-old hasn't been targeted across the last two games and should continue to serve a depth role with Mike Evans now healthy.

injuries.shortComment: James rushed twice for seven yards during Sunday night's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: James went without a touch on offense for the majority of the game, but he was able to turn the team's final two carries of the game into seven yards late in the fourth quarter. The running back was on the field for five offensive plays, and he'll remain the team's No. 3 option behind Christian McCaffrey and Kaelon Black in Week 12 against the Seahawks.

injuries.shortComment: Juszczyk caught both of his targets for 13 yards during Sunday night's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: Juszczyk was able to reel in his first two passes since Week 7, notching his fourth multi-catch performance of the year. The fullback has now caught 10 of 13 targets for 89 yards and two touchdowns while also adding a four-yard rush over nine contests to open the 2026 season.

injuries.shortComment: Watkins brought in his lone target for 19 yards during the 49ers' 35-10 win over the Vikings on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Watkins' 28 offensive snaps were tied with Deebo Samuel for second most among 49ers wide receivers behind Keenan Allen (31) and ahead of Mike Evans (23). Watkins has played at least 50 percent of San Francisco's offensive snaps in each of the team's last five games, but the second-year pro is stuck in a complementary role on offense behind Evans, Allen, Samuel, tight end George Kittle and running back Christian McCaffrey. The 49ers travel back home for a critical Week 12 tilt against the Seahawks on Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said after Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings that McKivitz is believed to have sustained a fractured and dislocated left ankle during the contest, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: McKivitz was carted off the field after going down with the injury during the second quarter, when Vikings linebacker Ivan Pace appeared to roll up on back of McKivitz's left leg at the end of a Christian McCaffrey run. Assuming follow-up tests confirm the injuries, McKivitz will require surgery and will almost certainly miss the remainder of the regular season and playoffs. Vederian Lowe came off the bench to replace McKivitz at right tackle, and Shanahan confirmed that Lowe will be next in line to start at the position beginning with the 49ers' Week 12 matchup with the Seahawks.

injuries.shortComment: Pineiro made all five of his PATs in Sunday night's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: It was the veteran kicker's third game this season that he didn't attempt a field goal, but he's now gone three straight games with exactly five extra points. Pineiro now leads the league in both point-after attempts (40) and makes (36), but he's attempted just 11 field goals in a highly efficient San Francisco offense. The lack of field goals certainly keeps him from being a top fantasy kicker.

injuries.shortComment: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said Monday that Lenoir is still dealing with a foot injury, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Lenoir played in Week 11 despite working through a foot injury that was sustained in Week 9 against Las Vegas. The issue didn't seem to slow the 27-year-old against the Vikings, as he played 81.0 percent of defensive snaps, which was within his usual range.

injuries.shortComment: Allen totaled three catches (on four targets) for 38 yards during Sunday's 35-10 victory against the Vikings in Mexico City.
injuries.longComment: Sunday marked Allen's first time working with Mike Evans, the 49ers' top wide receiver, and the latter dominated the attention of QB Brock Purdy, posting a 6-109-1 line on seven targets in his first game action since Week 6. If Evans' Achilles issue flares up at any point, Allen may be thrust into WR1 duties, which could yield more consistent results as he becomes more acclimated to head coach Kyle Shanahan's offense. For now, though, Allen will play a distant second to Evans for as long as the latter is healthy and available.

injuries.shortComment: Black notched six carries for eight yards and secured his only target for seven yards during Sunday's 35-10 win versus the Vikings in Mexico City.
injuries.longComment: Black entered Week 11 action on the heels of three consecutive contests with double-digit touches, so Sunday's performance was a step back to his modest outings from Weeks 2-6. In any case, the rookie third-round pick continues to be utilized regularly in the 49ers offense, averaging 9.1 touches for 37.8 yards from scrimmage per game while working as the clear No. 2 RB behind Christian McCaffrey. Black's next chance to contribute arrives next Sunday against the Seahawks.

injuries.shortComment: Samuel logged two carries for 27 yards, gathered in three of four targets for 20 yards and returned two kickoffs for 57 yards during Sunday's 35-10 win against the Vikings in Mexico City.
injuries.longComment: Samuel didn't come close to replicating the 109 yards from scrimmage and two TDs on six touches that he accrued during a Week 10 shootout in Dallas, but he continued to mix into the offense in all realms, as he's ranged from two to eight touches in each of his seven appearances this season. Overall, he's averaging 11.7 yards per catch and a whopping 13.1 yards per carry to go with five total touchdowns in 2026, making him one big play away from producing weekly.

injuries.shortComment: Kittle caught all three of his targets for 34 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: Kittle scored on both of his first-half catches, capping San Francisco's opening drive with a 17-yard touchdown before adding an eight-yard score in the first minute of the second quarter. The multi-touchdown performance was especially impressive considering the Vikings came in having allowed just one touchdown on a league-low 33 catches to tight ends. Kittle has been one of the top performers at his position as usual, with seven touchdown catches in 10 games, though his streak of consecutive outings with at least four catches ended at eight games. Up next for Kittle is a Week 12 home game against the Seahawks.

injuries.shortComment: Purdy completed 21 of 26 pass attempts for 255 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: Purdy remained effective despite facing the vaunted Vikings defense, which had allowed just six touchdown passes through nine games. He threw touchdown passes on three of San Francisco's first four drives, connecting with George Kittle for scores of 17 and eight yards before finding Mike Evans for a four-yard touchdown in Evans' first action since Week 6 due to an Achilles injury. Purdy will take a stellar 23:5 TD:INT into another tough matchup on paper in Week 12 against the Seahawks, who held him to a season-low 189 passing yards in Week 5.

injuries.shortComment: Evans (Achilles) caught six of seven targets for 109 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: Evans picked up where he left off in his first action since Week 6, leading the team in catches, receiving yards and targets. He has 316 receiving yards in his last three healthy games and has scored four times in seven appearances for the 49ers, including a four-yard touchdown catch in the second quarter of Sunday night's win. Evans will likely have his practice reps managed as usual ahead of a Week 12 home game against the Seahawks, but he looks poised to continue suiting up, barring a setback.

injuries.shortComment: McCaffrey rushed 12 times for 49 yards and a touchdown while catching both of his targets for 13 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: McCaffrey was relatively quiet in the lopsided win, but he extended his touchdown streak to nine games with a six-yard touchdown run in the fourth quarter. The versatile running back was much less involved as a pass catcher Sunday night after racking up 161 yards and two touchdowns through the air against the Cowboys in Week 10, and he finished with a season-low 62 scrimmage yards against the Vikings. Backup Kaelon Black had just eight rushing yards on his six carries after siphoning off at least 11 rushing attempts in each of the previous three games. McCaffrey is set to face another stout defensive front in Week 12 when the 49ers host the Seahawks, against whom McCaffrey churned out 83 scrimmage yards and a touchdown in Week 5.

injuries.shortComment: Jones (illness) is active for Sunday night's matchup against Minnesota, Brooke Evans of the 49ers' official website reports.
injuries.longComment: Jones is good to go for Sunday Night Football after dealing with an illness at practice throughout the week. The quarterback will operate in his primary reserve role behind starter Brock Purdy versus the Vikings in Mexico City.

injuries.shortComment: Robinson (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday night's contest against the Vikings, Brooke Evans of the 49ers' official website reports.
injuries.longComment: Robinson will take a seat after appearing in each of the team's last two contests. With Mike Evans returning to action Sunday night after missing three contests with an Achilles injury, Robinson is the odd man out in the 49ers' WR room.

injuries.shortComment: Hobbs (groin) has been downgraded to out for Sunday night's game against the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: The veteran cornerback remains on injured reserve but had been listed as questionable. He had his 21-day practice window opened 17 days ago, so the 49ers will need to make a decision on Hobbs next week. He's yet to play in a game this season.

injuries.shortComment: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Darnold (quadriceps/rib) made a "good bit of progress" over the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and will start Sunday at San Francisco if he fares well during Wednesday's practice, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Darnold has been sidelined for the Seahawks' last two games due to a quad issue and a cracked rib, but he was back on the field Monday for a bonus practice coming out of the bye week. While Macdonald relayed that Darnold "looked great"  and took "a ton of reps" during what the coach referred to as more of a walk-through session, the Seahawks want to see how the veteran quarterback responds to a full-speed practice Wednesday before giving him the green light to start in Week 12. After leading the Seahawks to their second Super Bowl championship in 2025, Darnold has endured a rough start to 2026, completing 60.2 percent of his passes and posting a 10:9 TD:INT while missing nearly four full games due to injury.

injuries.shortComment: questionable
injuries.longComment: questionable

injuries.shortComment: doubtful
injuries.longComment: doubtful

injuries.shortComment: questionable
injuries.longComment: questionable

injuries.shortComment: The Seahawks placed Holani (knee) on injured reserve Monday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Holani was knocked out of the Seahawks' last game in Week 10 at Las Vegas due to a knee injury that eventually was deemed to be an MCL sprain. Per Brady Henderson of ESPN.com, head coach Mike Macdonald said he was uncertain if Holani will require surgery, but the running back will be sidelined for at least four games by virtue of landing on IR. In the meantime, Emanuel Wilson will serve as the team's No. 3 back behind Zach Charbonnet and Jadarian Price.

injuries.shortComment: Witherspoon logged four solo tackles, including 2.0 sacks, in the Seahawks' 21-13 win over the Raiders on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Coach Mike MacDonald dialed up the blitz against rookie first-overall pick Fernando Mendoza in his first career start. Two of Witherspoon's four tackles in the Seahawks' win came behind the line of scrimmage off cornerback blitzes against Mendoza.
